name: DeadMoon Survival
source:
Humanity is on the brink of collapse, society is no more, and the only thing left is the screams of the undead, echoing across the desolate streets of a long-gone civilization. DeadMoon Survival is a choice-based visual novel where you will shape the world's fate. Are you going to become a badass monster slayer, or will you cry in a corner swallowing your own snot? Maybe you are willing to become something else for the sake of those you hold dear... a monster.

[From Itch.io]
translation:
人類瀕臨崩潰，社會已不復存在，只有亡者的嘶吼，在昔日文明荒涼的街道間迴盪。《DeadMoon Survival》是一部以選擇為核心的視覺小說，你將塑造世界的命運。你會成為強悍的怪物殺手，還是躲在角落裡，哭得一把鼻涕一把淚？又或許，為了珍視之人，你願意變成另一種存在……怪物。

[摘自itch.io]
